# Kaeduas

> Kaeduas is the creative practice of Qophe Junior Motsamai (QJ), a South African graphic designer and creative producer based in Bloemfontein and working worldwide. The practice focuses on graphic design, social content strategy and human-led generative video.

## Key facts
- Founder: Qophe Junior Motsamai ("QJ Motsamai"), graphic designer and creative producer
- Base: Bloemfontein, South Africa; available worldwide
- Services: graphic design for digital, print, packaging, point-of-sale and retail activation; social content strategy; generative video
- Video work: Chicken Licken social video concept; Luxe Homme × Kabza De Small product film study
- Design concept: ORUVI, a fictional botanical soda identity shown across digital, print, packaging, point-of-sale and retail activation
- Downloadable samples: Kaeduas Creative Brand Guide and ORUVI Fictional Brand Concept Guide (PDF)
- Production approach: human direction and creative decisions, with photography, live-action production, generated imagery and editing as appropriate
- Booking: WhatsApp +27 67 236 3235 or motsamai.main@gmail.com
